Commentary.Commentary: Right then! Not what we hoped for but that concludes the ODI series. We now look forward to welcoming you to the T20I series. The three-match T20I series will start on Wednesday, 27th July at 11 pm IST (5.30 pm GMT). Do join us for the build up, well in advance. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

This has been a disappointing game and the finale has been left incomplete. The series will be shared by the two teams as the rain gods have won here at Headingly. South Africa decided to bat first after winning the toss and got off to a decent start thanks to Quinton de Kock. He lost his opening partner Janneman Malan pretty early but constructed a lovely partnership with Rassie van der Dussen to take South Africa to a comfortable position. The partnership was broken just before drinks after which Aiden Markram and Quinton de Kock played through an interruption to keep the scoreboard ticking. Quinton de Kock remained unbeaten on 92 off just 76 deliveries to keep South Africa in the hunt for a series win but no further action was taken thanks to the pouring.

We have bad news for you. The match has officially been called off! South Africa and England share the series as it ends on 1-1. We were all set for a Super Sunday thriller with the series on line but the rain gods had other plans and the biggest enemy of cricket had the last say. We were nearing the cut off time but the forecast does not look good. The officials have taken the call in advance and decided to abandon the game. Not the end to the series we were hoping for!

Update - 8.16 pm IST (2.46 pm GMT) - With the way things seem to be going, it looks like Quinton de Kock will miss out on his century. That said, he will be pleased that he got some runs under his belt after missing out in the first two games. Just to add some positive news amidst this glum setting, the audience will be refunded half the price of the tickets if the game does not happen hereafter.

Update - 7.42 pm IST (2.12 pm GMT) - It is still raining in Headingly and the delay seems to be substantial. If South Africa do not get to bat and England get to play their 20 overs the target will be 175. Now, the whole ground is covered as the groundsmen are expecting the rain to stay for a long duration. You can enjoy the action between India and West Indies but also keep an eye here for further updates.

South Africa scored 40 runs in the 41 deliveries that were bowled in the short session between the two breaks. Jos Buttler decided to operate with spin from both ends, to try and bowl as many overs as possible before another interruption. Quinton de Kock has moved into the 90s and will be hoping he gets to come out and complete a much-deserved century. Aiden Markram has played second fiddle but has looked solid at the other end.

Update - 7.15 pm IST (1.45 pm GMT) West Indies are off to a watchful start in Port of Spain. Switch tabs and check out the action but do join us once again for additional updates as we wait for the game to resume.

Update - 7.04 pm IST (1.34 pm GMT) - The rain is pouring down AGAIN. The players are walking off the field and the covers are on. It looks like a stop-start day here at Leeds and more overs will be deducted after this break. Stay tuned for further updates.
Moeen Ali goes a fraction short and delivers this outside off, Quinton de Kock stands tall and punches it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up full outside off, Quinton de Kock fends this to the cover fielder.
This one is full outside off, Aiden Markram works this towards long on for a single.
Moeen Ali flights this full on middle, Aiden Markram taps this towards mid-wicket and looks for a single. Quinton de Kock sends him back.
Again given width outside off. Quinton de Kock drives it through covers and Jonny Bairstow has to do the sweeping work in the deep. Two.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Quinton de Kock is looking so good here! Given a bit of air, full and outside off. He caresses it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle. Markram eases it to long on for a single.
A leggie, flatter and on middle. Markram rocks back and punches it back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off. Quinton de Kock slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Too full and outside off. Markram drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Liam Livingstone is into the attack.
Moeen Ali serves this full outside off, Aiden Markram strokes this to long on for a single.

FOUR! Aiden Markram executes the reverse sweep to perfection! Moeen Ali serves this full and angling into leg, Aiden Markram gets on his knees and reverse sweeps the ball over the backward point fielder for a boundary to the deep backward point fence. Aiden Markram is playing a good supporting role to Quinton de Kock.
Moeen Ali flights this full on middle and leg, Aiden Markram flicks this through the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace.
This one is a fraction short and angled into the batter, Quinton de Kock goes back in the crease and punches it towards deep cover for a single.
Goes full once again and in line with the stumps, Quinton de Kock fends this back down the pitch.
Moeen Ali flights this full and on middle, Quinton de Kock makes room and works this through covers for a couple of runs.
A googly but on the shorter side. Markram turns it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Quinton de Kock punches it through covers for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Markram makes room and forces it to long on for one.
On middle, fuller and it is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Rashid sees Quinton de Kock going for a reverse sweep. He bowls it slow and well outside off. De Kock gets some bat on it and plays it to third man for four.
Fuller and on middle, drifting in. Markram works it to long on for a single.
Slower ball, full and angling on the pads. Quinton de Kock fails to flick it away and gets hit on the pads.
Touch slower and on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Tosses this one full outside off, Aiden Markram uses his wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
This one is a fraction short and angled into the stumps. Aiden Markram makes room and punches it towards cover.
Angles this into the pads from a slightly shorter length. Aiden Markram nudges it towards square leg.
Adil Rashid goes full outside off, Quinton de Kock fends this back down the pitch.
Serves this quick into the pads on a fuller length. Quinton de Kock flicks this to mid-wicket.
Serves this short and wide outside off. Aiden Markram punches it to deep cover for a single.
This ibe us flighted full outside off, Aiden Markram pushes at the ball and gets beaten by the spin.
Quicker delivery bowled full outside off, Quinton de Kock works this to long on for a single.
FOUR! Adil Rashid bowls this full on leg, Quinton de Kock goes for the reverse sweep and places it through backward point for the first boundary after the break!
This is full and angled into the pads, Aiden Markram clips this towards mid-wicket.
Flighted full outside off, Quinton de Kock hits this to deep cover for a single.
Serves a full toss outside off. Quinton de Kock plays this towards cover. Jason Roy dives and stops the ball.
Goes 'round the wicket and outside off, Quinton de Kock defends this towards the cover fielder.
Full and on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Moeen Ali begins with a full delivery in line with the stumps, Aiden Markram fends it back towards the bowler.
Adil Rashid tosses this one full on the pads, Quinton de Kock knocks it back to the left of the bowler.
We are all set to resume. The players are out in the middle. Both the batters are out as well. Adil Rashid to complete his over.

Update - 6.35 pm IST (1.05 pm GMT) - Both sides will play 45 overs each. Elsewhere in the world of cricket, West Indies have won the toss and elected to bat against India. Do switch tabs to check the playing XIs and then join us for the resumption of this game.
Update - 6.20 pm IST (12.50 pm GMT) - Good news! The game is set to resume at 6.45 pm IST (1.15 pm GMT). If there is no more rain. Stay tuned.

Update - 6.10 pm IST (12.40 pm GMT) - There will be an inspection in 5 mins at 6.15 pm IST (12.45 pm GMT). The news from the middle is that the rain has stopped for now and the ground staff are working hard to clear things up. But, the forecast suggests there will be another couple of showers soon. Fingers crossed. Stay tuned.

Update - 5.49 pm IST (12.19 pm GMT) - The umpires were out in the middle without any umbrellas. They are assessing the conditions but there is no sign of covers coming off. If this delay continues and South Africa's innings were to end here, England would need 170 runs in 20 overs as per DLS. The forecast for later seems to be much better though and we are still some time away from overs being deducted. Stay tuned for more updates.

Update - 5.37 pm IST (12.07 pm GMT) - Meanwhile in Galle, Sri Lanka have put on a good batting display to end Day 1 on 315 for the loss of 6 wickets. They got off to a good start scoring 92 runs for the opening partnership. However, they will be disappointed that despite all batters getting off to good starts, none of them could go on to make a big score. Dinesh Chandimal continued his good form and was dismissed for a well-made 80. Pakistan will be happy that they kept breaking crucial partnerships at regular intervals. They will be disappointed though, that they conceded an excess of 300 runs. What a wonderful contest we have on the cards!

Update - 5.20 pm IST (11.50 am GMT) - The game was going perfectly for South Africa before the break. After opting to bat, they were off to a watchful start but lost Janneman Malan early. The duo of Quinton de Kock and Rassie van der Dussen added 75-runs to get the team back on track. Quinton de Kock is looking in a good rhythm now and will hope to score a ton here. The pitch is good to bat on and South Africa will look to cross the 300-run mark. Regarding the weather, the whole ground is covered now as the rain has gotten much heavier. Stay tuned as we bring you more updates.

Update - 4.54 pm IST (11.24 am GMT) - It is raining heavily now. The crowd covers themselves. The umpire asks the players to walk off the field and the rain has interrupted play. The good news is that only the pitch is covered and not the whole ground. There is some sunlight on the horizon and that is a good sign. Stay tuned for further updates.
Adil Rashid goes full and in line with the stumps. Aiden Markram knocks the ball to long on and takes an easy single.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Quinton de Kock guides this ball to the left of short third man and takes a quick single.
Adil Rashid serves this full on the pads, Quinton de Kock plays this towards fine leg and takes a brace. David Willey does a good job to prevent the ball from running into the boundary.
This one is tossed up full outside off, Aiden Markram thumps it to deep cover for a single.
Flights this full on middle and leg, Aiden Markram hits this straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Two runs! On a length and outside off. Quinton de Kock guides it through point. Deep cover comes across and cuts it out. Two.
Straight on the pads. Markram eases it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Drops it pace and bowls it around middle. Quinton de Kock nudges it to square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Markram carves it to third man for a run.
Length and on off. Pulled to deep square leg for one more.
On a length and on middle. Quinton de Kock plays with an angled bat to point.
Slower ball, fuller and outside off. Quinton de Kock reverse sweeps it through point for a single.
A googly, not much turn. This is full and on off. Quinton de Kock blocks it out on the front foot.
The rain seems to be getting slightly heavier now. Does not look good as the towels are out to keep the ball dry.
Flatter and on middle. Quinton de Kock drills it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slants it on middle. Markram forces it to square leg for a single.
Floats it up, full and on off. Markram gets inside the line and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, outside off, driven to mid off.
There is a slight drizzle around and the sky seems to be dark. They continue to play at the moment.
Bowls it full and on off. Markram plays off the inside half of the bat and to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Markram shoulders arms.
Wide! Tries to angle it across but this is wide of off. Left alone for a wide.
Again outside off, this is left alone.
Short in length and outside off. Markram shoulders arms to it.
Keeps the same line and length. Markram gets on his toes to block it.
Short in length, angling on the pads. Quinton de Kock wrists it to deep square leg for one.
On middle, pushed through covers for a single.

Was that a chance? This is full and around off. Markram drives it to the left of Rashid who dives that side and gets low but fails to catch it. He instead parries it to long off for one. 100 up for England.

DRINKS! The players take drinks as the umpire seemed to be changing his microphone batteries. South Africa have gotten off to a decent start courtesy of Quinton de Kock's half-century. They will be disappointed with the loss of two wickets. However, the platform has been set to take them to a reasonable total. England will be hoping they can keep chipping into the wickets and restrict South Africa. Aiden Markram walks out to the middle to accompany Quinton de Kock.

OUT! TAKEN! The 75-run stand is broken and England have done well to set the field here! England were changing the field each ball, taking their time and keeping Rassie van der Dussen guessing! Rashid floats one full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen gets on his knee and slog-sweeps it, flat and straight to deep square leg where Jonny Bairstow takes it with ease. It was a much-needed breakthrough as these two were scoring freely but England will hope to stem the run flow here.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Better from Rashid! Targeting the stumps. Tossed up on middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
Tossed up outside off. Quinton de Kock steps across and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sliding on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cheeky from de Kock! Short ball on middle. Quinton de Kock waits and places it over the keeper for a boundary. Still five runs of the over.
On a length and around off. Rassie van der Dussen punches to the right of short cover and takes a single.
Length ball, outside off at 115 clicks. Rassie van der Dussen hits it to point.
Curran gets it to tail back in, on a length and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to mid-wicket.
Length and on top of off. Rassie van der Dussen gets inside the line and works it to covers.
Fuller and around off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to covers.
Ends the over much better than he started! Serves this full and in line with the stumps. Quinton de Kock fends this back to the bowler. 11 runs of the Adil Rashid's first over.
This is served full and angling away from the left-hander. Quinton de Kock leaves this one alone and is inside the wide line.
WIDE! This is full and wide outside off, Quinton de Kock leaves this one alone. The umpire calls this wide.

Adil Rashid is not getting his length right as he serves this short and angling down leg. Rassie van der Dussen misses out as he pulls this towards short fine leg who gets a hand to it and restricts them to a single.
This one is short and wide as well, Quinton de Kock slashes at it hard but gets the toe end of his bat towards deep point for a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Quinton de Kock as he reaches his half-century! Adil Rashid bowls this short outside off, Quinton de Kock uses the crease and thumps it to deep cover for another boundary! Quinton de Kock has gotten off to a good start in this game and will be looking to make it big!
FOUR! Adil Rashid has been welcomed with a boundary! Adil Rashid serves this full outside off, Quinton de Kock goes back in the crease and plays it late to the right of short fine leg for a boundary!
Adil Rashid is into the attack.

Bangs this one short and angling towards the off side, Rassie van der Dussen goes to pull this leg side but plays under the ball as it goes through to the keeper. A stifled appeal from the bowler and the keeper.
Serves this a fraction full and angling away from the batter. Rassie van der Dussen gets well behind this and taps it towards cover.
Sam Curran bowls this on a good length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen fends this towards the cover fielder.
This is banged in short and angled into the batter, Quinton de Kock pulls this to deep square leg for a run.
Off-cutter bowled on a length outside off, Rassie van der Dussen guides this to third man for a single.
Sam Curran serves this on a good length and on the hips. Quinton de Kock stays back and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Sam Curran to bowl now.
Too full and on off, pushed back to the bowler by Rassie van der Dussen.
Moeen Ali goes full and on middle, Rassie van der Dussen flicks this to square leg.
FOUR! Width given here, outside off, it is on the shorter side. Rassie van der Dussen slaps it hard and through covers for a boundary.
Moeen Ali continues bowling full outside off, Rassie van der Dussen goes for the reverse sweep and gets a couple of runs to deep backward point.
This is full outside off, Quinton de Kock drives this towards mid off and rushes across for a single.
Around the wicket to the left-hander and angles this in from outside off. Quinton de Kock fends this solidly.
Reece Topley bowls this one is on a good length outside off, Rassie van der Dussen clips this towards square leg.
This is close to the off stump on a good length. Rassie van der Dussen fends this towards the cover region.
Bowls this full once again outside off, Quinton de Kock gets across the stumps and plays it towards mid on for a single.
This is full outside off, Quinton de Kock leaves this one alone.
WIDE! Pulls his length back a fraction and angles it down leg. Quinton de Kock leaves it alone and is called wide by the umpire.

FOUR! This one is beautifully timed! Reece Topley goes a fraction full and outside off. Quinton de Kock leans into the shot and plays it past short cover with sublime timing. Rushes to the deep cover boundary to add four more runs to the total! Quinton de Kock is looking in fine nick here!
Reece Topley serves this on a good length outside off, Quinton de Kock punches this back towards the bowler who stops it and falls on the floor.
This is full on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen flicks this towards square leg.
There is spin on offer here, Moeen Ali serves this full outside off and gets the ball to turn into the batter. Rassie van der Dussen nudges it to mid on.
This is quicker and on off, Rassie van der Dussen goes back in the crease and punches it towards mid on.

FOUR! Rassie van der Dussen plays this smartly! Moeen Ali serves this full and straight, Rassie van der Dussen gets across the stumps and paddles it over the wicket-keeper's head for a boundary to fine leg!
Goes over the wicket to the right-hander, and serves this full and outside off. The ball goes straight and Rassie van der Dussen fends it off his back foot.
Moeen Ali serves this full on middle, Quinton de Kock taps this towards cover with soft hands and rushes across for a single.
Powerplay 2! England will be allowed to place four fielders outside the circle now till the 40th over.
A dot to end the over! South Africa have done well after losing Malan! On a length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen hops and blocks it out.
Bowls a length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock drops it in front of covers for a single.
FOUR! Cleaver, really clever! Just uses the pace here as this is outside off. Quinton de Kock opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a boundary.
BEATEN! Goes wide of the crease and angles a length ball, outside off, it holds its line. Quinton de Kock is beaten as he tries to defend on the outside edge.
On a length and on off, pushed to the man at cover-point.
FOUR! Good start to the over! South Africa have completely changed the gears! Overpitched and outside off. Quinton de Kock uses his feet and caresses it through covers for four.
Around off, fuller, eased down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful boundary! Perfectly placed! Pitched up, outside off. Quinton de Kock drives it on the front foot, through covers for a boundary.
On middle, blocked out.
TAP AND RUN! Flatter and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen turns it to mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Angling on the pads. Quinton de Kock nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, angling on off, driven to covers.
On the pads, Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to square leg.
Fuller and on off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Third off the over! Expensive one by Willey! On a length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it on the up and just wide of covers for another boundary.
Outside off, it is hit through point for a single.
FOUR! Two in a row! Quinton de Kock takes the charge! Short in length and outside off. Quinton de Kock shuffles way across and pulls it through fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! No slip and the chance goes begging! Goes fuller and around off, hint of away shape. Quinton de Kock comes down the track and looks to loft over mid off but gets an outside edge and it goes to third man for four.
A loopy ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen strides forward and looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This is full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse sweeps it past short third man for a couple of runs.
Pitched up on middle. Rassie van der Dussen lunges and blocks it out.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
EDGED AND FOUR! Tossed up, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen prods to defend but does inside the line and it goes off the outside edge and races into the third man fence.
Starts with a fuller ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to mid off.
Moeen Ali has been brought into the attack.
Drags his length back and serves it outside off. Quinton de Kock punches on the up and to point.
Pitched up and outside off. Quinton de Kock pushes it to mid off, straight to the fielder.
Full and outside off, angling across. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to the left of mid off for a quick single.
Willey keeps it full and outside off, it is pushed to point.
Fuller and on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it to mid off.
Rassie van der Dussen walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! England get the breakthrough! This is on a length and angling outside off, it nips away off the surface. Malan tries to push across and away from the body. It takes the outside edge and goes to point where Jason Roy takes it to his right. Malan will be disappointed with the shot. He was watchful but a lapse of concentration cost him his wicket. England draw first blood and David Willey looks absolutely thrilled!
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length and on the pads, Janneman Malan clips this past mid-wicket for a quick single. 10 runs of the over and a good one for South Africa.

FOUR! Janneman Malan gets the second boundary of the over! This one is short and outside off, Janneman Malan charges down the wicket and has to reach for the ball. Manages to get enough bat on it to take it over Moeen Ali at mid off and run away to the fence for another boundary! Janneman Malan seems to be tired of just hanging around!
Reece Topley adjust his length and goes a fraction short, in line with the stumps. Janneman Malan defends this back down the pitch.

FOUR! Janneman Malan gets his first boundary now! This is full outside off, Janneman Malan advances down the wicket and lifts the ball over mid off. Does not time this well but still manages to get the ball to the boundary!
This is on good length outside off, Janneman Malan fends this towards point.
Reece Topley begins with a full delivery outside off, Quinton de Kock works this through cover-point for a single.
Janneman Malan shimmies down the wicket and catches the ball on the full outside off. Hits it well, straight to the mid off fielder.
Bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Janneman Malan knocks this towards mid on.
David Miller serves this a full outside off, Quinton de Kock covers the line and pushes the ball to mid on for a single.
This one is a fraction short and outside off, Quinton de Kock hits this straight to the point fielder.
This one is full and outside off, Quinton de Kock plays this towards cover.
FOUR! First boundary for South Africa! David Miller goes full and strays onto the pads, Quinton de Kock clips this off his pads through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Good length outside off, Janneman Malan knocks this towards cover-point.
This is full as well, and on off, Janneman Malan looks to work this leg side and gets a thick outside edge towards point. Good stop by the fielder to prevent a run.
Reece Topley goes full this time and outside off, Quinton de Kock gets a stride out and places this through cover for three runs.
WIDE! Bangs this one in short and into the batter. Quinton de Kock ducks under this and lets the ball through. The umpire calls this wide on height.
Reece Topley continues bowling good length outside off, Quinton de Kock fends this back towards the bowler.
This is on a good length and angling into the batter, Quinton de Kock mistimes his shot back down the pitch.
Reece Topley bowls a ripper! Serves this just outside off on a good length, Quinton de Kock hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
This is a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Janneman Malan hits this hard to back to the bowler who puts his left hand down and stops the ball. David Willey begins with a maiden over.
Serves this on a good length outside off, with a scrambled seam. Janneman Malan goes for a shot and beats his outside edge.
On a good length once again, on middle and leg. Janneman Malan taps this towards mid on.
David Willey serves this one a good length outside off. Gets a bit of extra bounce as Janneman Malan fends this towards point.
Goes straight on a good length, Janneman Malan fends this back towards the bowler.
David Willey starts with a good length delivery, around off and gets it to nip back in. Janneman Malan nudges it to mid on.
David Willey to bowl from the other end.
Good delivery from Reece Topley to end the over! Bowls on a good length just outside off, Quinton de Kock feels for the ball and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Reece Topley serves this on a good length and into the pads, Janneman Malan clips this to square leg for a run.
This one is in good length outside off, Quinton de Kock punches this towards mid off and takes a quick single.
Bowls a full toss wide outside off, Quinton de Kock hits it straight to point.
Serves this full outside off, Quinton de Kock finds the gap through cover and takes a brace.
Reece Topley starts with a full delivery on the pads, Janneman Malan flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. There is a bit of misfield but the fielder at mid on cuts it out.

We are all set for the action. Both the teams are going unchanged. The sun is out but it's a bit cloudy as well. The openers of South Africa - Quinton de Kock and Janneman Malan are out in the middle. Reece Topley to start with the ball. Here we go...
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Philip Salt, Joe Root, Moeen Ali, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, David Willey, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley.

South Africa (Unchanged Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Janneman Malan, Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius, Keshav Maharaj (C), Anrich Nortje, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

Also, another big factor in this game will be the rain. While the heat wave took the news in the first game. The rain gods had major say in the second one. The conditions are the same here in Leeds but we hope the rain doesn't play a spoilsport.
